privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.englishOnly: This policy is published in English, which is the authoritative version.

meta.title: Support
meta.description: Get help with ClippingKK: importing highlights, your account, billing and privacy.

support.title: How can we help?
support.description: ClippingKK is an independent project. When you write, a person reads it.

email.title: Email us
email.body: Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened. Screenshots help.

import.title: Importing from Kindle
import.body: Connect your Kindle to a computer, open the documents folder and add My Clippings.txt on the Import page of your library.

account.title: Recovering an older account
account.body: If you used to sign in with a phone number, WeChat, a wallet or a different Apple email, email us from the address you use now and we'll help link your old library.

billing.title: Billing and subscriptions
billing.body: Manage or cancel Premium from Subscription settings. For refunds or anything unexpected on your bill, email us.

privacy.title: Privacy and your data
privacy.body: Read how we handle your data, or ask us to export or delete it.
